summary: Report missing target prerequisites during adoption

delivery.outcome: Goal adoption reports target-owned required files still missing after its complete managed installation plan without creating them or changing package drift semantics
nonGoals: No automatic creation or modification of target-owned prerequisite files
No stack-profile, manifest, schema, dependency, version or release change
No Goal-side policy duplication, downstream product mutation or external delivery

architecture.decision: Compute missing target prerequisites from the target manifest against existing files plus planned adoption payloads, then emit informational deterministic lines while retaining existing adoption and drift behavior
interfaceChanges: Adoption stdout may include MISSING target prerequisite <path> informational lines
architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket; adoption returns to reporting managed drift only

validation.evidence: An empty target reports only required files absent after the complete payload plan and remains unwritten in check mode
Managed files are excluded and creating the target-owned fixture removes its warning
Package up-to-date and drift exit codes remain zero and one respectively despite informational prerequisite lines

commands: all commands from the Linux CI test job
validation.evidence: Focused/full contracts and downstream integration retain baseline while exposing the new report
